title: Add per-entry freshness to sutra_review responses
description: sutra_review responses lack per-file/per-symbol freshness indicators. Other tools (sutra_map, sutra_find) include per-result _freshness via freshness::check_file(). PRD story 22 requires per-result freshness envelope.\n\nIn gather_change_stats(), call freshness::check_file() for each changed path and include in per-file and per-symbol JSON entries.

acceptance_criteria.text: Each changed_file entry in review output includes _freshness field

messages.author: codex
messages.text:
Codex review (adversarial): needs-attention

[medium] recommended_reads and affected_symbols carry file paths but omit _freshness. A stale/deleted affected file can be marked stale_index in affected_files while the same path is still recommended for review or surfaced through affected_symbols, with no warning on those entries.

Recommendation: include _freshness on recommended_reads and affected_symbols entries. Add regression tests for stale/edited paths in those arrays.

messages.author: agent
messages.text: Addressed codex review finding in c0efd69: extended _freshness to recommended_reads and affected_symbols. All file-backed entries now consistently include freshness."
